**Breaking:** Non-breaking

## Why it waits

An index built now would be tuned against 411 node titles with no prose behind them. Ranking tuned against titles alone is ranking tuned against the wrong signal, and it would need rebuilding the moment real content arrived.

**The cost of waiting, stated.** `F-06` serves the problem solver, who is the more common arrival (`PRJ-005`). Until search works, the site serves sequential readers well and problem solvers barely. Accepted for the duration of alpha and not beyond it.

## Definition of Done - additions

- [ ] The index size is measured against `WEB-014` S2 and stated, not estimated. If it does not fit the budget, the budget or the index changes by decision - neither is quietly exceeded.
- [ ] Ranking behaviour is documented in `WEB-008` with worked examples, so a later change can be recognised as a regression.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Searching a concept by its exact name returns its chapter first.
- [ ] Searching a term that appears only in the glossary returns the glossary entry.
- [ ] Search covers node statements, not titles alone - a query matching the substance of a node returns it even where the title does not match (`KG-002`).
- [ ] A query with no results says so plainly and offers the browse route, rather than showing an empty list.
- [ ] Search is usable by keyboard from the trigger through to opening a result.
- [ ] Results are announced to assistive technology when they change.
- [ ] The index is built at build time. No search query leaves the reader's browser (`TEC-4`).
- [ ] Total added client JavaScript, including the index, is within budget.

## Definition of Done - universal

Inherited by every implementation task. `RDM-011` S1 holds the single copy.

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] The `CI` status check passes on the pull request (`WKF-004`)
- [ ] Merged by pull request from a branch; never committed to `main` directly
- [ ] Human-written commenting matching the codebase (`WKF-007`)
- [ ] Keyboard reachable, visible focus, correct semantics; no new AA regression (`DSY-011`, `WEB-012`)
- [ ] Both themes; above and below the responsive breakpoints (`WEB-011`, `DSY-010`)
- [ ] The JavaScript budget still holds (`WEB-014` S2)
- [ ] No specification left in conflict with the work (`CST-001`)
- [ ] Decisions recorded (`D-####`); architectural ones get an ADR (`WKF-013`)
